tier1.text: An esophageal artery brings blood to the esophagus, the tube from the mouth to the stomach. There are several of these arteries, and each branches off the aorta, the largest artery in the body. They come off the thoracic aorta, the part of the aorta whose branches supply the organs of the chest.
